title: Private endpoint
description: A private endpoint that gives an existing Azure resource (storage, Key Vault, SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, registry, Service Bus, web app ...) a private IP address in a subnet, with optional private DNS registration.
security_defaults: Automatic approval only works for resources this identity manages; otherwise the connection is refused, never silently pending

target_resource_id.description: Resource ID of the service to connect to (an output of another deployment).

subresource.description: Which part of the service: blob/file/queue/table/dfs/web (storage), vault (Key Vault), sqlServer (Azure SQL), postgresqlServer, Sql (Cosmos DB NoSQL), registry (ACR), namespace (Service Bus / Event Hubs), sites (web app).

subnet_id.description: Subnet that receives the private IP.

private_dns_zone_ids.description: Private DNS zones (privatelink.*) to register the endpoint in.

outputs.private_ip_address: Private IP assigned to the endpoint
